# Openshelf

> The latest research from people's own websites, collected every day. Research reports and explainers that people publish on their own websites (personal pages, lab blogs,
> company research sites), found through author feeds, archives and discussion sites, each checked by a language model,
> with the posts that answer them linked as threads. Chinese edition: https://chenxiachan.github.io/openshelf/zh/

## Data (free to reuse under CC BY 4.0; linked works belong to their authors)
- [All posts, responses and editorial decisions (JSON)](https://chenxiachan.github.io/openshelf/data/openshelf.json)
- [Front-page data with summaries in English and Chinese (JS)](https://chenxiachan.github.io/openshelf/shelf-data.js)
- [Atom feed, English](https://chenxiachan.github.io/openshelf/feed.xml)
- [Atom feed, Chinese](https://chenxiachan.github.io/openshelf/zh/feed.xml)
